capabilities: Return edited line text without writing files
Report Tasks status and error codes
extras: Minimal provider with no commands, editor features, or network access; it never writes files (edits go through Verbex's Diff approval). Requires Verbex 0.2.0+ and shows a notice with older Verbex. Automated tests use a fake Tasks API rather than the real plugin.
intentEvidence: lets the Verbex AI agent compute Tasks check-off results, including recurrence, through the Tasks plugin
problem: The Verbex AI agent has no way to compute Tasks check-off results, including recurrence, without directly editing note files.

relations.evidence: the first Verbex release that hosts Bridges
The Bridge calls its apiV1.executeToggleTaskDoneCommand(line, path)
Listing is done with a Dataview TASK query (Verbex Dataview Bridge, when installed)

summary: Bridge plugin that lets the Verbex AI agent compute Tasks check-off results, including recurrence, via the Tasks plugin without writing files.
